output.subject: Your HELOC draw request
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for calling us about your home equity line of credit. We understand this is time-sensitive, and we want you to know your concerns have reached the right people.

You told us that you submitted an $18,000 draw on your HELOC four days ago and that it still shows as pending review. You mentioned that your contractor is due to start work on 10/4 and needs a deposit before then, so you asked us for an update on the status of the draw and for the funds to be available before that start date.

We can hear how much depends on this. Waiting on money you need for a home project, with a contractor's schedule to work around, is stressful, and we're sorry for the worry this has caused.

Our Mortgage Servicing team will review your request, including the timing you described, and we will respond within 10 business days. If anything changes with your contractor's schedule, please let us know so we have the full picture.

Thank you for your patience while we look into this.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Check the current status of the $18,000 draw before sending; it may have been released or declined since the call.
The 10-business-day response window likely runs past the 10/4 contractor start date. Decide whether to contact the customer sooner by phone.
Decide whether to tell the customer why the draw is under review. The draft deliberately does not mention the manual review or the reason for it.
Confirm with the HELOC team whether the expedite request from the representative was received and acted on.
Do not commit to funds being available by 10/4 unless the HELOC team confirms it.
Confirm which year 10/4 refers to and whether it is month/day.
